claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_variant_family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing MagicItemRecord shape only supports one fixed rarity and one fixed mechanics payload per record. This unit is a single SRD family spanning three item variants whose attack-roll bonus changes with rarity, so one honest record needs a way to bind rarity and granted bonus together instead of collapsing to an arbitrary representative tier.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Wand, Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3) ... you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls determined by the wand's rarity.
